Weight-at-age data used in Taboada et al. (2023): 
```{r}
# load FLStock object

load("C:/Use/GitHub/ices-tools-dev/SEAwise/SEAwise_T3.3/NEA/data/FLStocks_in/bob/wghansa2022_aneq.stk.RData")
aneq.stk <- window(aneq.stk, end=2022) # remove 2023 (incomplete)

# load mean weight-at-age from JUVENA

dat <- read.csv(file="C:/Use/proyectos/IM-23-SIZANE/analisis/data/juvena/Bio_Juv_ANE-2003_2022.csv", header=T)

dat.haul <- dat %>% 
  group_by(y, sample, age) %>% 
  summarise(l=mean(lmm, na.rm=T),
            w=mean(w, na.rm=T)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(age))

dat.haul <- pivot_wider(dat.haul, names_from=age, values_from=c(l, w),  names_sep = "")
dat.haul <- right_join(select(dat, c(lon:individual, fpw0p)), dat.haul, multiple="first") 
dat.haul$year <- dat.haul$y

dat.ts <- dat.haul %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  summarise(w0=weighted.mean(w0, w=fpw0p, na.rm=T), 
            l0=weighted.mean(l0, w=fpw0p, na.rm=T))

# create new FLStock object with weight-at-age 0 from JUVENA

aneq.stk2 <- aneq.stk 
stock.wt(aneq.stk2["0",]) <- 0
stock.wt(aneq.stk2["0", as.character(dat.ts$year)]) <- dat.ts$w0

df <- as.data.frame(stock.wt(aneq.stk2))
df <- subset(df, select=c("age","year","data"))
df <- pivot_wider(df, values_from = "data", names_from="age", names_prefix="w")

aneq.biol <- as(aneq.stk2, "FLBiol")

df <- left_join(df, as.data.frame(ssb(aneq.biol)))
df <- df %>% 
  rename(ssb=data) %>% 
  mutate(w0=ifelse(w0==0, NA, w0/1000)) %>% 
  select(-c("age","unit","season","area","iter"))

df <- df %>% 
  mutate(logw0=log(w0),
         logw1=log(w1),
         logw2=log(w2),
         logw3=log(w3),
         logssb=log(ssb))


```
